retrieved.educational: The encoder -decoder attention layer helps align words in the input with the output sequence.• Self-Attention in transformers layer Self-attention in transformers is a mechanism that allows words in a sentence to interact with each other to determine which words to focus on. • It uses three value to get word embeddings queue, value and key.• Here are the key points: Self -attention enables words within an input sequence to interact and understand the context by attending to other relevant words.○ Encoding Process : Each word is encoded into three vectors: query, key, and value.
